research.notes: No registry record (Maryland SDAT, SAM.gov, California SOS) was checked, so legal name, entity numbers and UEI are left null. Headquarters left null because sources conflict: TEDCO says Columbia, MD; several directory sites and Technical.ly say Baltimore, MD. No page found that mentions Oakland Unified directly. Phone and email are as shown on the company website.

profile.summary: EliteGamingLIVE is a company that runs a video game (esports) league and a science, technology, engineering and math (STEM) learning program for students in grades 3 through 12. Schools and youth organizations use it as an after-school program. Students compete in games and also work through lessons about technology careers.

sources.title: Elite Gaming Live teaches esports career opportunities beyond just becoming a pro gamer
TEDCO Invests in Elite Gaming Live

review.notes: The distinctive name, the Columbia, MD location (TEDCO) and the after-school esports/STEM program for grades 3-12 all match the agenda's EliteGamingLIVE, Inc. and its after-school contract. The summary, website, phone and generic business email were confirmed on the company site and Technical.ly, and the summary is neutral. Headquarters is rightly left null because the sources conflict (Columbia vs Baltimore).
